cvr_path_root.description: Directory that every cvr_path in contest_set.csv is relative to.

round_by_round_table.description: Round-by-round vote counts, transfers, and active percentages per candidate, as csv.

round_by_round_json.description: Round-by-round results as json in the RCVis format.

first_choice_to_finalist.description: For each first-choice candidate, where those ballots ended up among the finalists.

condorcet.description: Head-to-head counts and percentages between every pair of candidates, plus the Condorcet winner.

first_second_choices.description: Distribution of second choices for each first-choice candidate.

cumulative_rankings.description: Cumulative count and percentage of ballots ranking each candidate at or above each rank.

crossover_support.description: For each candidate's first-choice voters, how many also ranked each other candidate.

split_stats.description: Contest statistics recomputed for each value of the contest's split_fields columns.

per_rcv_type_stats.description: Contest statistics for all contests, one csv per tabulation variant.

per_rcv_group_stats.description: Contest statistics for all contests, one csv for single-winner and one for multi-winner contests.

per_rcv_group_stats_fvDBfmt.description: The per_rcv_group_stats csvs with columns reordered to match the FairVote database import format.

candidate_details.description: One csv across all contests with each candidate's round-by-round vote counts and outcome.

winner_final_pile_rank_distribution_tabl.description: One csv across single-winner contests: at which rank the winner's final-round ballots ranked the winner, as marked and after rules are applied.

candidate_rank_usage.description: One csv across all contests with how many rankings each candidate's first-choice voters used.

convert_cvr_rank_format.description: Write each CVR as a rank-column csv (one column per rank).

convert_cvr_candidate_format.description: Write each CVR as a candidate-column csv (one column per candidate holding the rank).

annotated_cvr_rank_format.description: Write each CVR with the internal per-ballot tracking columns added. Large; for debugging.

ballot_stats_debug.description: No longer produced. Accepted so that old run_config.json files still load.

cvr_ballot_allocation_rank_format.description: No longer produced. Accepted so that old run_config.json files still load.

cvr_ballot_allocation_candidate_format.description: No longer produced. Accepted so that old run_config.json files still load.
